_note: Eligibility rules used by the Scheme Navigator tool. Every rule carries its own source. VERIFY each rule against the official portal before the final submission - some fields are marked VERIFY where our team has not yet confirmed them.

schemes.name: PMEGP
schemes.what_it_gives: Capital subsidy (margin money) on a new micro-enterprise project
documents: Aadhaar (shown at the centre, not stored by Arithva)
PAN card
Project report with cost breakdown
Caste or special-category certificate, if claiming the higher rate
Education certificate, if the project cost crosses the threshold that requires it (VERIFY)
Rural-area certificate from the Gram Panchayat, for the rural rate
schemes.confidence: VERIFY subsidy bands and the education-certificate threshold against the current scheme guidelines before submission

schemes.name: PM MUDRA - Shishu
schemes.full_name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana, Shishu category
schemes.what_it_gives: Collateral-free loan up to Rs 50,000 for a micro business
documents: Aadhaar (shown at the bank, not stored by Arithva)
PAN card
Two passport photographs
Proof of business address
Last six months' bank statement, if an account exists
Quotation for the machinery or stock being bought
schemes.apply_at: Any bank, NBFC or MFI, or the Jan Samarth portal
schemes.confidence: Loan ceiling is well established; VERIFY document list with the specific lender

schemes.name: PM MUDRA - Kishor
schemes.full_name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana, Kishor category
schemes.what_it_gives: Collateral-free loan above Rs 50,000 and up to Rs 5,00,000
documents: Aadhaar (shown at the bank, not stored by Arithva)
PAN card
Proof of business address and vintage
Last six months' bank statement
Quotation for the machinery or stock being bought
Income proof or ITR, if the lender asks (VERIFY per lender)
schemes.apply_at: Any bank, NBFC or MFI, or the Jan Samarth portal
schemes.confidence: Loan band is well established; VERIFY document list with the specific lender

schemes.name: PM SVANidhi
schemes.what_it_gives: Working-capital loan for street vendors, starting at Rs 10,000, rising on timely repayment
documents: Certificate of Vending or identity card from the Urban Local Body
Aadhaar (shown at the centre, not stored by Arithva)
Bank account details
Letter of Recommendation from the ULB, for vendors without a vending certificate
schemes.apply_at: pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in, or through a Common Service Centre
schemes.confidence: VERIFY whether the tranche ladder and the interest subsidy are unchanged in the current year

schemes.name: PM Vishwakarma
schemes.full_name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme for traditional artisans and craftspeople
schemes.what_it_gives: Skill training with a stipend, a toolkit incentive, and collateral-free credit in two tranches
documents: Aadhaar (shown at the centre, not stored by Arithva)
Proof of practising the trade
Bank account details
Ration card or family details
schemes.apply_at: pmvishwakarma.gov.in, usually through a Common Service Centre
schemes.confidence: VERIFY tranche amounts and the eligible-trade list against the current guidelines
